title: Beautiful tree..you wont be dissapointed!!
text: Beautiful tree..you wont be dissapointed!!. I have a love for trees, especially ones that light up indoors. This one is the 24 inch. It looks great on an end table, or even on the floor in a dark corner that just needs that special lighting. The branches are metal wrapped in white. There are about 3 layers of branches. The bottom layer has  2 sections of the tiny lights to give it a fuller look. You bend down each branch and shape them, then you seperate the thin wires that have the fairy lights. Be careful with these as some are twisted around each other. Take your time. Then you can shape and fill in spots with these lights. They are very easy to shape. The only problem I had was the trunk of the tree is on an angle where it meets the base so it looks like its leaning. It can not be bent back or you chance breaking it. I just faced the angle diferent when I put it on the table. Has an on/off switch that is easy to use. I really love this tree!!!
